note.zh-TW: 教材用「股東權益」，現行報表的科目名稱是「權益」；本站的主要顯示跟著教材。
note.en: The course materials say shareholders' equity; current Taiwanese statements use the shorter heading equity. The site follows the course wording.

definition.zh-TW: 資產減去負債後剩下、屬於股東的部分；股東投入的本錢加上公司累積下來的盈餘。
definition.en: What is left for the owners after subtracting liabilities from assets: the capital the owners put in plus the profits the business has kept.
